title: Keith's loggia pedestals plain, as the 1888 plate shows them
items: At 1808 Prairie, the two pedestals under the loggia's columns now carry plain panels in their stone border. Read at full size, the 1888 Inland Architect plate shows no carving in them, so the leaf scrolls drawn there before are gone.
The stone's colour was checked against the 1965 colour slide's own whites and greys. They can't pin a tint, so the house keeps its neutral grey.
